'''Winter Orb''' is a [[channelling]] [[spell]] [[active skill|skill]]. Channelling the skill charges up an orb, which fires icy projectiles that deal [[cold damage]] in an [[area of effect]] where they land.  

==Skill functions and interactions==
Projectiles from Winter Orb don't directly collide with enemies, and accordingly cannot [[split]], [[pierce]], [[fork]], [[chain]], or [[return]]. Its projectiles benefit from both area damage and projectile damage modifiers.

===Projectile Rate===
Base projectile rate at stage 1 without any increased cast speed is .833 per second.

The first stage does not gain projectile frequency. Therefore 8 stages gives (7 X 20) = 140% increased projectile frequency. The plus 2 maximum stages at 20% quality adds 40% projectile frequency.

All cast speed modifiers are additive with the increased projectile frequency. Therefore a 10 stage winter orb with 100% cast speed has (180 + 100) = 280% total increase projectile frequency.

80% more projectile frequency will multiply your projectile fire rate by 1.8 while channelling.

Example of projectile fire rate while channelling at 10 stages and 100% increased cast speed:
*{{math|formula=
 {1 \over 1.2} \times (1 + .2 \times 9 + 1) \times (1 + .8) = .833 \times 3.8 \times 1.8 = 5.7 \text { per second}
}}

===Area of Effect===
Each projectile's area damage can hit the same target, depending on the projectiles' area of effect, the player's proximity to the target, and the size of that target. Because additional projectiles are fired in a rough line rather than a cluster, additional projectiles require greater area of effect to overlap. A total of 3 projectiles reliably overlap without area investment. With 5 projectiles, a radius of 2.6~2.8 metres is considered optimal.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/PathOfExileBuilds/comments/1iy18aa/a_brief_analysis_of_winter_orb_overlaps_its_aoe/</ref> 

===Interactions===
'''Nova''': Making Winter Orb fire in a [[Nova_(projectile_behaviour)|circle]] with e.g. {{il|Sire of Shards}} or {{il|Black Zenith}} causes projectiles to spread out in each direction, each set landing a similar distance away from the caster. Additional projectiles will be added to the circle rather than fire in a line, meaning additional projectiles do not require increasingly larger areas of effect to overlap.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/PathOfExileBuilds/comments/wo3vjm/another_try_at_black_zenith_winter_orb/iki5o6u/</ref>

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.30.0|
* Now fires 2 Projectiles at all gem levels (previously 2-3 at gem levels 1-20).
* Now has 70% Effectiveness of Added Damage (previously 80%).
* Now deals 40 to 59 Cold Damage at gem level 1 (previously 39 to 59), scaling up to 307 to 460 at gem level 20 (previously 360 to 539).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.29.0|
* Now fires 2-3 Projectiles at gem levels 1-20 (previously 1 at all gem levels).
* Now has a 25% chance to Freeze (previously 0%).
* Now has a Critical Strike Chance of 7.5% (previously 6%). 
* Now deals 360 to 539 Cold Damage at gem level 20 (previously 360 to 450).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.28.0|
* Projectile Speed modifiers now affect the time it takes for projectiles to impact the ground (previously projectile speed had no effect on Winter Orb).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.27.0|
* Now Fires projectiles every 1.2 seconds (previously 1.6), and now has 80% more Projectile Frequency while Channelling (previously 125%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.26.0|
* Now has 80% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 60%). It now deals 39 to 49 Cold Damage at gem level 1 (previously 30 to 37), scaling up to 360 to 450 at gem level 20 (previously 270 to 337). It now has a Maximum of 8 Stages (previously 10), with 30% increased Duration per Stage (previously 25%). It also now has 125% more Projectile Frequency while Channelling (previously 150%), and 20% increased Projectile Frequency per Stage (previously 15%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now provides +0-2 Maximum Stages, instead of 0-10% increased Cast Speed.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.17.0|
* Winter Orb now deals 30 to 37 Cold Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 270 to 337 at gem level 20 (previously 232 to 291). 
* Now has 150% more Projectile Frequency while Channelling (previously 100%). 
* Now has 60% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 50%).
}}
